27.text: "I won a prize at the handicrafts fair. Mama didn't seem to care that much, though."

34.speaker: Narrator

35.speaker: Deana
35.text: "Mama's in there. I'll be up in my room till dinner."

36.speaker: Narrator
36.text: I followed her with my eyes as she went upstairs, thinking about the days when she idolized me. She was starting to look more and more like her mother.

37.speaker: Narrator

40.speaker: Player_Italic

51.speaker: Narrator

107.speaker: Narrator
107.text: The four of us gathered around the dining room table. Monica ladled out bowls full of beef stew -- not my favorite, but a comforting dish nonetheless.

108.speaker: Player
108.text: "Now that we're all here, I wanted to say something."

111.text: "I know the past four years have been hard on all of us."

112.speaker: Player
112.text: "The past four years have been the hardest in my life."

113.speaker: Player
113.text: "The past four years have tested our strength as a family."

114.speaker: Player
114.text: "I was so busy focusing on the needs of the Sordish people that I forgot about Sordland's most important people: my own family."

115.speaker: Player
115.text: "I let my power get to my head. I became unrecognizeable to myself -- and to all of you."

116.speaker: Player
116.text: "I've done some unforgivable things. Especially to you, Monica."

117.speaker: Player
117.text: "I hope I can redeem myself someday."

118.speaker: Player
118.text: "I hope someday, we'll be able to put this behind us and be a family again."

119.speaker: Narrator

120.speaker: Player
